newsitem.title: CHINA: China mulling east China LNG power station.
newsitem.headline: China mulling east China LNG power station.

text.p: Chinese energy officials are considering building a multi-billion dollar liquefied natural gas (LNG) power plant in the energy-hungry Yangtze river delta, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The first phase of the proposed power station would cost $2.0 billion and have a generating capacity of 2,400 megawatts, Xinhua said.
The project would have storage facilities for 3.0 million tonnes of LNG a year and a 150,000 dead weight tonne berthing area for LNG tankers, the agency said.
The project was discussed at a Yangtze river delta LNG project seminar in Hangzhou, capital of eastern Zhejiang province, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
